update_dlss_fg.label: DLSS Frame Generation

update_dlss_rr.label: DLSS Ray Reconstruction
update_dlss_rr.sub: Cleaner ray-traced reflections, shadows and global illumination.

update_streamline.label: NVIDIA Streamline plug-ins (advanced)
update_streamline.sub: Master switch for every sl.* Streamline DLL. Off by default — they are a version-locked set, so swapping them can crash games (especially with DLSS Enabler). NGX DLLs are unaffected.

update_reflex.label: NVIDIA Reflex
update_reflex.sub: Lower input latency in supported titles.

update_xess.label: Intel XeSS

update_fsr.label: AMD FSR

update_direct_storage.sub: Faster game loading via direct NVMe → GPU streaming.

auto_apply_all_on_rescan.label: Auto-apply updates on rescan
auto_apply_all_on_rescan.sub: Off by default. Enable for unattended updates.

autoUpdate.title: Auto-update

customFolders.title: Custom folders
customFolders.help: Add directories where you keep games outside of standard launchers (e.g. {path}). Each subfolder will appear as a Manual entry in the Library.

launcherOverrides.title: Launcher overrides
launcherOverrides.help: Default paths come from the Windows registry. Add a manual fallback only if a launcher is installed outside its standard location.

steamCdn.title: Steam public CDN
steamCdn.help: Default. DLSSync resolves your manual/custom games against the Steam store search and fetches the public CDN art (header, hero, capsule). No key required.
steamCdn.sub: Every game without art is resolved automatically. Falls back to letter glyph for titles Steam doesn't index.

sgdb.help: For pirated, modded or super-niche titles that Steam doesn't index, SteamGridDB has community art. Free key on your SGDB profile.
sgdb.helpMuted: We don't ship a bundled key — SteamGridDB rate-limits per key (1,000 req/day free tier), so a shared key would exhaust the quota across all DLSSync users.

steamApi.help: Improves Steam title matching beyond what local {manifest} already provides. Get a free key at {site}.
steamApi.helpMuted: We don't ship a bundled key — Valve's Steam Web API Terms §2 require each key holder to keep it confidential and not share with third parties. Each user's key stays in their own {file}.

overlay.label: DLSS Debug Overlay
overlay.sub: Adds NVIDIA's on-screen overlay showing DLSS version, mode, and frame timing.

verboseLogs.label: Verbose logs
verboseLogs.sub: Capture full debug output to {dir} under the data folder.

preferStable.label: Prefer stable channel
preferStable.sub: Hide experimental and beta builds from the version picker. Recommended.

allowUnsigned.label: Allow unsigned DLLs
allowUnsigned.sub: Bypass the Authenticode publisher gate. Every apply still checks SHA-256, but the vendor signature is no longer required. Off by default.

parallelApplies.label: Parallel applies
parallelApplies.sub: How many vendor-archive groups to install in parallel. Higher = faster on fat connections, lower = gentler on flaky links. 1–4, default 2.

network.title: Network
network.sub: Download client tunables — defaults are sane; tweak only if your link is unusual.

retry.label: Retry attempts per download
retry.sub: How many times a flaky archive download retries before failing. Exponential backoff between attempts. 1–6, default 3.

chunkTimeout.label: Per-chunk timeout (seconds)
chunkTimeout.sub: Maximum gap allowed between byte chunks before aborting and retrying. 10–600, default 60.

connectTimeout.label: Connect timeout (seconds)
connectTimeout.sub: Maximum TCP connection establishment time. 3–60, default 10.

cacheTtl.label: Download cache TTL (seconds)
cacheTtl.sub: How long a downloaded vendor archive stays in memory for sibling DLLs that share it. 60–3600, default 300.

dlssOverrides.title: DLSS Overrides
dlssOverrides.sub: DLSS preset and frame-generation overrides moved to the {drivers} tab, alongside your GPU driver updates. Per-game overrides stay in each game's detail drawer.

recommended.label: Recommended (latest)
recommended.desc: Lets NVIDIA pick the best model per quality mode — Preset M for Performance, L for Ultra Performance, K for the rest. Best default for most users.

default.label: Use app default
default.desc: Leave the game's own DLSS model untouched — no preset is forced.

k.label: Preset K — Transformer (latest)
k.desc: DLSS 4 transformer model. Best image quality — sharper, more stable, less ghosting — at a higher GPU cost. Default for DLAA / Quality / Balanced.

j.label: Preset J — Transformer
j.desc: DLSS 4 transformer, close to K with slightly less ghosting but a touch more flicker. K is generally preferred over J.

l.label: Preset L — Transformer (Ultra Perf)
l.desc: DLSS 4.5 second-gen transformer tuned for Ultra Performance / 4K — sharpest and most stable, highest cost. RTX 20/30 lack FP8 so it is heavier there.

m.label: Preset M — Transformer (Perf)
m.desc: DLSS 4.5 second-gen transformer tuned for Performance mode — near-L quality at roughly J/K speed.

e.label: Preset E — CNN (legacy)
e.desc: Legacy convolutional model. Prefer a transformer preset (K) on RTX unless a specific game misbehaves with it.

f.label: Preset F — CNN (legacy)
f.desc: Legacy CNN tuned for Ultra Performance / DLAA at 4K and above.

c.label: Preset C — CNN (legacy)
c.desc: Legacy CNN variant for fast-paced games — less ghosting at the cost of temporal stability.

d.label: Preset D — CNN (legacy)
d.desc: Legacy CNN variant for slower-paced games — more temporally stable but more ghosting.

n.label: Preset N — Transformer
n.desc: DLSS transformer preset N. Shown so a profile set in the NVIDIA app or Profile Inspector is respected.

o.label: Preset O — Transformer
o.desc: DLSS transformer preset O. Shown so a profile set in the NVIDIA app or Profile Inspector is respected.

a.label: Preset A — CNN (legacy)
a.desc: Legacy CNN preset. Prefer a transformer preset on RTX unless a game misbehaves.

b.label: Preset B — CNN (legacy)
b.desc: Legacy CNN preset. Prefer a transformer preset on RTX unless a game misbehaves.

g.label: Preset G — CNN (legacy)
g.desc: Legacy CNN preset. Prefer a transformer preset on RTX unless a game misbehaves.

h.label: Preset H — CNN (legacy)
h.desc: Legacy CNN preset. Prefer a transformer preset on RTX unless a game misbehaves.

i.label: Preset I — CNN (legacy)
i.desc: Legacy CNN preset. Prefer a transformer preset on RTX unless a game misbehaves.

app_controlled.label: Use app setting
app_controlled.desc: Keep the in-game Frame Generation setting unchanged.

fixed.label: Fixed multiplier
fixed.desc: Force a fixed multiplier (2×/3×/4×, up to 6× in supported titles). 'App controlled' count keeps the in-game 2×.

dynamic.label: Dynamic (DLSS 4.5)
dynamic.desc: Automatically shifts the multiplier to hit your target frame rate / refresh rate. RTX 50 only. Not compatible with frame-rate limiters or V-Sync.

app_controlled.label: App controlled
app_controlled.desc: Let the game/driver choose the Frame Generation multiplier.

x2.label: 2× Frame Generation
x2.desc: One generated frame per rendered frame. Supported on RTX 40 and RTX 50.

x3.label: 3× Multi Frame Generation
x3.desc: Two generated frames per rendered frame. RTX 50 only.

x4.label: 4× Multi Frame Generation
x4.desc: Three generated frames per rendered frame. RTX 50 only.

note.adminElevation: Windows installs per-machine drivers only with Administrator rights, so Update shows a UAC prompt. DLSSync stays unelevated and runs a signed helper with your approval — it snapshots the current driver and sets a System Restore point first, so you can roll back.
note.enablerManaged: DLSS Enabler requires NVIDIA Streamline 2.11 or newer but does not update it, so DLSSync updates the Streamline set within the same major version to keep the Enabler working. It never swaps the set across a major version.
note.streamlineOverride: Updating Streamline replaces the shared sl.* plug-in set. Per-game DLSS overrides keep working; NVIDIA App global preset and ratio overrides may need to be set again. If a game misbehaves, restore the previous set from Backups.
